items.title: Regulus (Turner)
items.description: Regulus is an oil painting by the English artist J. M. W. Turner, currently housed in Tate Britain, London. It was initially painted in 1828 and overpainted twice, first between 1829 and 1837, and again in 1837. items.title: Russell Brand
items.description: Russell Edward Brand is an English comedian, actor and media personality. He rose to prominence as a reality television presenter in the early 2000s before starring in major comedy films, releasing several stand-up specials and hosting radio shows. In 2026, he was convicted of rape and sexual assault, and his imprisonment is expected to last until 2033.

items.title: Ramayana: Part 1
items.description: Ramayana: Part 1 is a 2026 Indian Hindi-language epic mythological film directed by Nitesh Tiwari, who co-wrote the screenplay with Shridhar Raghavan. Produced by Namit Malhotra and Yash, the film is based on the Hindu epic Ramayana by Valmiki. items.title: Jensen Huang
items.description: Jen-Hsun "Jensen" Huang is a Taiwanese and American electrical engineer and business executive who is the co-founder, president, and CEO of Nvidia, one of the world's most valuable companies. As of October 2026, Forbes estimates his net worth at over US$200 billion, making him the seventh-wealthiest individual in the world.

items.title: Abdul El-Sayed
items.description: Abdulrahman Mohamed El-Sayed is an American politician, epidemiologist, and academic who is the United States senator-elect from Michigan.

items.title: Godzilla Minus Zero
items.description: Godzilla Minus Zero  is a 2026 Japanese epic kaiju film written, directed, and with visual effects by Takashi Yamazaki. A sequel to Godzilla Minus One (2023), it is the 39th film in the Godzilla franchise, the 34th film thereof produced by Toho, and the sixth installment in the Reiwa era.
